findings.title: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` is now an uninstantiable abstract class
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` was changed to subclass `StatefulDetectorHandler` with only `pass` as its body, removing the concrete `evaluate` implementation it previously had. Because `StatefulDetectorHandler` defines abstract methods (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`), `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` remains an abstract class. Accessing `detector.detector_handler` (at `src/sentry/workflow_engine/models/detector.py:86`) for any detector of type `MetricAlertFire` (`metric_alert_fire`) will now raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...` instead of returning a no-op handler.

findings.title: `get_group_key_values` return type annotation excludes `None` group keys
findings.body: `StatefulDetectorHandler.get_group_key_values` is typed as returning `dict[str, int]`, whereas the rest of `StatefulDetectorHandler` (`get_state_data`, `evaluate`, `evaluate_group_key_value`, `build_occurrence_and_event_data`, and tests such as `test_state_results` with `{"group_vals": {None: 6}}`) uses `DetectorGroupKey` (`str | None`) as the dictionary key. The return type annotation should be `dict[DetectorGroupKey, int]` so subclasses returning `None` keys match the type contract.
